notes: One class of shares, priced from its primary listing on Euronext Paris (MC.PA) in EUR rather than the U.S. OTC ADR. Shares = 494,606,080 total shares − 743,358,184 gross + 739,382,278 net voting rights (parts signed so they sum to shares) = 494,606,080 − 3,975,906 = 490,630,174 at October 31, 2026. The monthly disclosure states no treasury count. Gross minus net voting rights equals the shares deprived of voting rights, which are the treasury shares: the same identity gives exactly the 1,295,928 treasury shares the 2025 URD reports at December 31, 2025 (744,843,762 theoretical − 743,547,834 exercisable votes). If a stated figure is preferred, the total including treasury shares is 494,606,080 (treasury about 0.8%). Share count fell from 497,686,940 at December 31, 2025 as LVMH retired repurchased shares.
